method: Parse GLB JSON/BIN; read indexed POSITION for TRIANGLES; apply glTF internal column-major transforms in meters then x1000; apply assembly occurrence row-major transforms in mm. Independently transform STEP_topology index bbox corners by same occurrence transforms. No CAD/STEP evaluation.
limits: Tessellated surface vertex bounds are mesh evidence, not exact BRep envelope or collision certification.
STEP hash difference alone does not prove geometric change; exporter timestamps and alternate scene rebuilds require separate tracing.

conclusion.x_max_cause: Selector component B601_link6/o1.1.186.1.2 has unmeshed faces f13 and f14. Each emits local zero bbox. Union with other face boxes artificially extends local xmax to0 and ymin to0, then8corner rotation reproduces Sxmax563.080613. Actual same-component refs meshSxmax428.368040; assembly actual meshSxmax511.485956 belongs to left finger.
conclusion.z_max_cause: Selector B601_link3/o1.1.183.2.1 contains no zero-triangle faces. Transforming its tight local meshAABB corners reproduces zmax610.069291; actual refs mesh zmax600.889208. Rotation loses shape correlation, giving a conservative boxcorner extreme.
conclusion.not_simple_whole_link_box_union: Source receipt has361 whole-part local boxes. Official selector uses742 deeper leafsolid prototype boxes, with distinct internal frames and null-mesh behavior; this is not the same box hierarchy. Whole-part local-box union max[532.546021,721.15,621.522621] is a separate quantity.
conclusion.bnd_box_role: assembly.json uses direct BRepBndLib.Add_s with useTriangulationFalse and a small gap. It is not the refs summary branch. Refs summary reads selector manifest.bbox, whose bounds are prototype face-meshbox unions transformed to world, including the zero-box pathology.
conclusion.step_provenance: Current STEP matches refs05ad2ce4; source-export package retains f110e6b7. Both packages were inspected through their own rendered triangle buffers, not inferred from snapshot appearance.
conclusion.delivery_interpretation: Keep source receipt bounds as declared direct placed-BRep measurement; cite refs bounds only as selector metadata envelope, not exact material extent. This audit does not prove full STEP geometric equivalence, repair unmeshed faces, or validate collisions.
